BrandingSettingsPanel.description: Shown in the header next to your company name. Paste a link to an image already hosted elsewhere (your website, a CDN, etc.).

LanguageSettingsPanel.description: Your company's default interface language, used by everyone signed in.
LanguageSettingsPanel.defaultLanguageHelperText: More languages are on the way — only fully translated languages are offered here.

TimezoneSettingsPanel.description: Used to display times consistently across reports and business hours.

ErpEnableToggle.description: Connect ERPNext to sync customer records. Once enabled, a new "ERP" tab appears here to configure the connection. Turning this off completely hides ERP everywhere — navigation, customer profiles, and reports — without losing a saved connection.
